repaired.name: Scenario

diagnosis.summary: The IR requires a 15-minute (900,000 ms) sustained wait before acting. The candidate uses a 100 ms wrapper with a threshold of 901 ticks, which corresponds to 90.1 seconds. This causes the action to fire at ~90 seconds instead of 15 minutes. Evidence F2 confirms the extra action at 90,000 ms. The threshold must be 9001 ticks (900,000 ms / 100 ms + 1) to match the 15-minute duration.
diagnosis.change_summary: Changed the hold threshold from 901 to 9001. This ensures the condition is sustained for exactly 15 minutes (9000 ticks) before the action executes, matching the IR's `for: 15 MIN` specification.
